author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content:
**Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator**
We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.
Quality level matching the attached characters
Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!
